input_text: To prove that Albert likes ice cream, the prosecution introduces evidence that Albert told Jim that "he wanted an ice cream."

extraction.input_text: To prove that Albert likes ice cream, the prosecution introduces evidence that Albert told Jim that "he wanted an ice cream."

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made out of court, as Albert communicated it to Jim prior to the trial proceedings.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(B) excludes statements made while testifying at the trial or hearing from the hearsay definition; thus, an out-of-court statement supports a finding of hearsay.
arguments.evidence_span: Albert told Jim that "he wanted an ice cream."

arguments.text: The statement contains a clear assertion of fact regarding Albert's past desire for ice cream.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(A) requires the declarant to assert the matter for the statement to qualify as hearsay.

arguments.text: The prosecution offers the statement specifically to prove that Albert likes ice cream, which relies on the truth of the statement itself.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) defines hearsay as a statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: To prove that Albert likes ice cream
